webhook_url.description: Write-only Discord, Slack, or generic webhook URL. It is encrypted at rest and never returned raw by API, UI, logs, audit metadata, delivery history, or diagnostics.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are not accepted.

email_recipients.description: Notification recipients. Required for email-channel creation by NotificationChannelCreateRequest. On update, omission preserves the existing masked recipient set; when supplied, the array must be non-empty.

uses_global_smtp.description: Email delivery is delegated to the service-authenticated Control Panel relay backed by globally managed SMTP settings.
